title: I AND CLAUDE MADE IT! <3, Finally released today my tower defense game "Get Outta My Gut". You can still try the demo and if you like it give the full version a try :D! Pretty happy how it turned out.
author: Life-Heron-6533
selftext:
**Steam Page:** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037960/Get\_Outta\_My\_Gut/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037960/Get_Outta_My_Gut/)

I managed it to make my first game in the genre **TOWER DEFENSE**. Defend your body against massive amounts of germs, draft turrets in **ROGUELIKE** style to build defenses, build paths to navigate enemies, **INCREMENTALLY** get stronnger by upgrades!

* ***Each Level adds new Mechanics to the GAME!*** (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ\*:・ﾟ✧
* **30 TOTAL TURRETS**
* **DOZENS OF ENEMY TYPES AND EFFECTS**
* **UPGRADE AND LEVEL TURRETS TO GET STRONGER IN THE RUN**

You need to position your turrets smart to counter the enemies or they will break through.

First levels are easy but difficulty will raise :D.

Give it a try and share some love <3

INDIE-SQUID
